protocol.substitution: User explicitly approved both Groq models in place of unavailable Mistral and Llama generative arms.
protocol.comparison: Production typed-node slot contract for both monolithic and source-reading-staged arms. Raw node fields are scored before compilation. Prepared only; not run. The compact-expression pilot is a separate, unpooled experiment.
protocol.privacy: Only regulation text, runtime catalogue type vocabulary and output contracts are sent; no drawings, plan images, observed plan measurements or frozen interpretations.
protocol.grading: Slot scores before validation; separate exact frozen requirement, reviewed meaning and retention. Unannotated scope is not counted as correct; API errors excluded.
protocol.purpose: Production SlotDraft compiler versus closed numeric linking; no expression generation. All development obligations; strict schema, no silent fallback.
protocol.grades: Source intent assistant-adjudicated separately from fixture IR; no human/independent review.
protocol.wire_revision: v4: finite strict schema; merge same-primitive string alternatives losslessly and eliminate redundant integer branch

method: UTF-8 bytes/4 to bytes/2, not a model tokenizer or provider token count. Includes schema; actual usage measured after successful calls.
